messages.subject: p-values calculated on beta values?
parts: Hi, I'm trying to figure out if p-values are calculated (by logistic regression) on beta values directly when comparing two groups.  The confusion arises because calculateDiffMeth() uses the weighted values to determine delta beta, but it's not totally clear if the p-value for a given CpG are calculated based on the beta values from the individual samples belonging to the two groups.  Thank you, Rajat

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] p-values calculated on beta values?
parts:
they are not calculated on beta values but on the deviance. We compare full model vs null model using the deviance in the simplest case with no covariates. We also don't report beta values (as in coefficients in the logistic regression model) I'm not sure how you are getting those.

Best,
Altuna
